blocks.html:
eLab is also available for producing videos for the USI community, offering a comprehensive service that includes designing, video shooting, post-production, and publishing.

Our team collaborates with all USI faculties and institutes, creating a wide range of audiovisual products based on specific needs, including:

  • Educational videos for online courses (MOOCs) and to support students in their studies and learning
  • Promotional videos for USI events or to present bachelor's and master's programs
  • Institutional videos for official events and the USI graduation ceremony
  • Custom video productions for specific projects

For video production requests, please contact us via the USI service portal.

Recording your video lessons

Teachers can use the Panopto software to record their own video lessons. This tool enables simultaneous recording of both the teacher and the screen display or PowerPoint presentation. For more information about Panopto, please visit the page dedicated to our tools and platforms.

People who wish to record video lessons, with the assistance of our staff and in a room equipped for optimal acoustic and visual quality, may use the Room 408 (fourth floor, Main Building, West Campus, Lugano). This room can be booked by sending an email to helpdesk@elearninglab.org.
